what: Named points of the Hamilton set for the camera solve (RULING GA), in the set frame of assets/hamilton-set.glb: metres, Y up, deck y 0.045, galleries y 2.743, upstage -z, house +z, stage left +x. From blocking.html's measured PLAN (the brief's glossary) and the posts clustered from the GLB's ham_post mesh (2026-10-14), corrected the same day from the leave-one-out census against the GLB (see `changes`). Each point: [x, y, z], a line on how to find it in a frame, and optional flags: `movable` (a unit that is not where it is put in every number - the solver should down-weight or drop it; a point set may simply omit it) and `approx` (a position from a secondary source, good to a few tenths of a metre - see its `see`).
changes: 2026-10-14 (set-point round): each change below was tested by leave-one-out (each point predicted by a solve without it, over every kept shot) before and after; values are set metres, mean residuals in metres at the point.

stair-sl-top [4.5, 2.743, -2.45] -> [4.37, 2.743, -2.5]: the GLB's top tread nosing / gallery landing edge is x 4.37, the treads' centre z -2.50 (treads z -2.83..-2.17); census x -0.19 -> -0.06 m. GLB + census.

stair-sl-foot [2.2, 0.045, -2.45] -> [2.21, 0.045, -2.5]: the GLB's bottom riser x 2.21, z as the treads. GLB only (census, 3-4 uses, still wants +0.18 m SL; the film's stair looks steeper than the model's 12 x 0.19 m run - not changed).

rail-us-sr [-4.27, 3.6, -2.97] -> [-4.1, 3.6, -2.97] and rail-srstrip-ds [-4.27, 3.6, -0.3] -> [-4.1, 3.6, -0.3]: census +0.15 / +0.19 m SL (24 / 8 uses, five set-ups) -> +0.02 / +0.02. The GLB puts this rail at x -3.86 (cap top x -3.92..-3.79); moved all the way there the census overshoots to -0.25 / -0.14, so the census value is kept.

bal-sr-ds [-5.65, 2.743, 3.25] -> [-5.19, 2.743, 3.37]: the GLB's SR balcony floor inner edge is x -5.19 from z 1.7 to its downstage edge z 3.37 (it steps out to -5.6 only upstage of z 1.7); census +0.33 m SL -> -0.02 (one set-up, the One Last Time / I Know Him pit camera). GLB + census.
rail-sr-ds [-5.63, 3.6, 3.25] -> [-5.19, 3.6, 3.37]: the rail stands on that edge (GLB cap x -5.24..-5.14, z to 3.43). GLB only: its one use (1-02 s0) went 0.06 -> -0.24 m.

Not changed: the rail height y 3.6 (the GLB's cap top is 3.658, gallery-to-rail 0.915 m; the census on rail-us-c, 38 uses, prefers 3.6: 3.658 with z -2.93 moved it -0.04 -> +0.09 m); rail-us-sl (census 0.01 m at x 4.6; the GLB says 4.31 and that made it +0.22); gal-sl-ds (census -0.1..-0.2 m toward centre from one set-up, the GLB says +0.16 the other way: conflict, left); gal-us-sr/-sl (census ~0 in x); lip-c (the GLB has no deck downstage of z 4.1 - the lip is the game stage's, straight at z 5.4-5.6; the census is inconsistent, sd 80-90 px, and the pit-camera set-up puts the clicked lip UPSTAGE of 5.4, not downstage - no bow is supported); the back-wall posts (all within 0.07 m).

stair-sr-* flagged movable: the GLB has no stair at x -4.5 (its only on-set stair is the SL one; the ETC pack lists 'Stairs SR' / 'SR Stair Unit' as a movable scenic unit), and the census residual of stair-sr-foot has sd 30-40 px across numbers. The solver should down-weight or drop it.
Added rig-3e-* and rig-6e-* (the two rows of lanterns seen over dark wides) from assets/hamilton-rig.json, flagged approx.
